evals.name: list-all-dashboards
evals.prompt: 我们目前有哪些看板？分别都是干嘛的？
evals.expected_output: Calls list_dashboards; presents each dashboard's name + intro + slug. Currently returns 1 row (强势股趋势监控 — Phase 1 MVP) and summarizes its intro.

evals.name: search-and-open
evals.prompt: 有没有关于美股强势股的看板？帮我打开看看
evals.expected_output: Calls search_dashboards with a keyword like '美股' or '强势股' (or list_dashboards if search misses); resolves the us-leaders-trend-monitor dashboard; calls get_dashboard to show its intro + entity coverage (12 symbols) + refresh cadence; asks permission before running `open <file_url>`.

evals.name: query-backing-data
evals.prompt: leaders 那个看板里的数据长什么样？我想看看背后的表
evals.expected_output: Resolves the us-leaders-trend-monitor dashboard (search/get_dashboard), takes its first source_table (e.g. scraw_aapl_daily), calls query_table(database='daas', table=..., limit=20), shows columns + a few rows + total row count, and names the source table.

evals.name: build-intent-redirect
evals.prompt: 给这几只港股做一个看板
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a BUILD intent, NOT a use intent; tells the user to invoke fd-daas-dashboard-creator; does NOT call any registry mutation tool. (This is a should-NOT-trigger / redirect case for this skill.)
